about.title: Ummat ki Behtareen Khidmat
about.lead: Al-Saleem Integrated Transport Company ek licensed Saudi transport operator hai jo muqaddas shehron mein zaireen ko aaraam, tahaffuz aur izzat ke saath le jaane ke liye waqf hai.
story: Haramain aane wala har mehman zindagi ke ek safar par hota hai. Hum ne Al-Saleem Transport ek saada yaqeen ke saath shuru ki: ke airport, hotel aur muqaddas maqamat ke darmiyan rasta is safar ka sab se aasaan hissa hona chahiye - kabhi fikr ka baais nahi.

Aaj hamare bharosemand drivers aur achhi dekhbhaal wali gaariyan Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah aur Taif mein mehmanon ki khidmat karti hain, ek airport pick-up se le kar mukammal Ziyarat tour tak. Humein waqt ki paband, shaffaf kirayon aur us dekhbhaal par fakhr hai jo hum apne khandanon ke liye chahte hain.
about.mission: Har zaair ko ek pursukoon, mehfooz aur ba-izzat safar dena - taake transport sochne ki ek kam cheez ho, aur ibadat markaz rahe.

faqPage.title: Aksar Poochhe Jane Wale Sawalat
faqPage.subtitle: Booking, qeemat, coverage aur aapke Ziyarat safar ke bare mein waazeh jawabat.

items.a: Tez tareen tareeqa WhatsApp hai. Hamare Abhi Book Karein safhe par booking form istemaal karein ya apne pick-up, drop-off, tareekh, waqt aur musafiron ki tadaad ke saath baraah-e-raast +966 50 068 9196 par paighaam dein. Hum minton mein aapka kiraya aur gaari tasdeeq karte hain.

Hum safar se pehle tay-shuda fixed, shaffaf kiraya istemaal karte hain - koi meter ya chhupi fees nahi. Qeemat raste, gaari ki qisam aur musafiron ki tadaad par munhasir hai. Durust qeemat ke liye WhatsApp par apne safar ki tafseelat bhejein.

items.q: Aap kin ilaqon ka ihata karte hain?
items.a: Hum Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah aur Taif ki khidmat karte hain, bashumool airport aur hotel transfer, aur darkhwast par poore Saudi Arabia mein safar karte hain.

items.q: Aapke paas kis qisam ki gaariyan hain?
items.a: Sedan (1-3 musafir), SUV (1-5), van jaise Toyota Hiace (6-11) aur coaster/bus (12+). Tamam gaariyan saaf, air-conditioned aur achhi dekhbhaal wali hain. Apne group ka size aur saman batayein, hum munasib gaari tajweez karenge.

items.q: Kya aap Jeddah aur Madinah se airport pick-up dete hain?
items.a: Ji haan. Hum Jeddah (King Abdulaziz International) aur Madinah airport se meet-and-greet transfer seedhe aapke Makkah ya Madinah ke hotel tak faraham karte hain, flight tracking ke saath taake aapke utarne par hum maujood hon.

items.q: Kya aap mukammal Ziyarat tour tarteeb de sakte hain?
items.a: Bilkul. Hum Makkah, Madinah aur Taif ke mubarak maqamat ke rehnumai-shuda Ziyarat tour aaraam-deh raftar se tarteeb dete hain, aise driver ke saath jo maqamat ko jaanta hai aur namaz o ghor-o-fikr ke liye aapke waqt ka ehtiram karta hai.

items.q: Kya aapke drivers professional aur licensed hain?
items.a: Ji haan. Hamare drivers bharosemand, tajurbekaar aur mohazzab hain, aur hum mukammal licensed Saudi transport company (License No. 35/00008116) ke tor par kaam karte hain.
Adaigi ke intezamaat booking ke waqt aapke saath WhatsApp par tay kiye jate hain. Hum sab kuch shaffaf aur pehle se tay-shuda rakhte hain.

Mansoobe badalte hain, khaas tor par Umrah aur Hajj ke douran. Barah-e-karam jitna jald mumkin ho WhatsApp par batayein aur hum kisi bhi tabdeeli ya cancellation ko adjust karne ki poori koshish karenge.
Ji haan. Flights aur manasik har waqt hote hain, lehaza aap din ya raat kisi bhi waqt WhatsApp par haqeeqi shakhs se rabta kar sakte hain.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Ye Privacy Policy wazahat karti hai ke Al-Saleem Integrated Transport Company ("hum") aapki website istemaal ya services book karne par maloomat kaise sambhalti hai.

sections.heading: Hum kaun si maloomat jama karte hain
sections.body: Jab aap sawari book karte hain to hum aapki faraham karda tafseelat jama karte hain - jaise aapka naam, phone number, pick-up o drop-off maqamat, safar ki tareekh aur koi notes. Agar aap WhatsApp ya email par rabta karte hain to hamein un paighaamaat ki maloomat mosool hoti hai.

sections.heading: Hum aapki maloomat kaise istemaal karte hain
sections.body: Hum aapki tafseelat sirf aapke transport ko tarteeb dene, tasdeeq karne aur faraham karne, aapki booking ke bare mein rabta karne, aur apni service behtar banane ke liye istemaal karte hain. Hum aapki zaati maloomat farokht nahi karte.

sections.heading: WhatsApp aur paighaam rasani
sections.body: Booking aam tor par WhatsApp par mukammal hoti hai. Aapke bheje paighaamaat WhatsApp ki apni privacy policy ke bhi taabey hain. Hum aapke paighaam ki tafseelat sirf aapki booking ki khidmat ke liye istemaal karte hain.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Hamari website aapki muntakhib zaban yaad rakhne ke liye ek maamooli cookie istemaal karti hai. Hum ise deegar websites par aap ko track karne ke liye istemaal nahi karte.

sections.heading: Data ki bardashti
sections.body: Hum booking tafseelat sirf itni muddat rakhte hain jitni khidmat faraham karne aur qanooni ya hisaabi taqaze poore karne ke liye zaroori ho, uske baad woh hata di jati hain.

sections.heading: Aapke huqooq
sections.body: Aap hum se poochh sakte hain ke hamare paas aapke bare mein kya maloomat hai aur ise durust ya hazf karne ki darkhwast kar sakte hain. Neeche di gayi tafseelat par rabta karein.

sections.heading: Rabta
sections.body: Kisi bhi privacy sawal ke liye, WhatsApp +966 50 068 9196 ya email info@alsaleemtransport.com par rabta karein.

terms.title: Terms of Service

sections.heading: Hamari services
sections.body: Hum licensed passenger transport faraham karte hain - airport transfer, hotel transfer, Ziyarat tour, Umrah o Hajj transport aur bain-ul-shehri safar - Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Taif aur poore Saudi Arabia mein.

sections.heading: Booking aur kiraya
sections.body: Kiraye fixed hain aur safar se pehle aapke saath tay kiye jate hain. Booking us waqt tasdeeq hoti hai jab hum aapki darkhwast ki tauseeq karein. Barah-e-karam durust pick-up tafseelat, waqt aur musafiron ki tadaad faraham karein taake hum behtar khidmat kar sakein.

sections.heading: Cancellation aur tabdeeli
sections.body: Agar aap ko booking tabdeel ya cancel karni ho to barah-e-karam jald az jald WhatsApp par batayein. Hum hamesha tabdeeliyon ko adjust karne ki koshish karenge, khaas tor par Umrah aur Hajj ke douran.

sections.heading: Aapki zimmedariyan
sections.body: Barah-e-karam tay-shuda waqt aur maqam par tayyar rahein, driver ki maaqool hifaazati hidayat par amal karein, aur gaari o driver ke saath ehtiram se pesh aayein.

sections.heading: Zimmedari
sections.body: Hum mehfooz, bar-waqt transport faraham karne ka bohat khayal rakhte hain, magar hum apne qaboo se bahar halaat jaise traffic, mausam, sadkon ki bandish ya urooj ke mausamon mein hujoom ki wajah se takheer ke zimmedar nahi.

sections.body: Ye sharait mamlikat Saudi Arabia ke qawaneen ke taabey hain.
